description: Five related questions on the mini C&H fixture. Task-1 builds the representation; tasks 2–5 reuse under tighter caps.

steps.instruction:
# Session Q1/5 — Exhaustive match set (build representation)

CRITICAL (scores 0 if ignored): Call `clawql_memory_recall` with
`schema="legal.Matter"` and
`filters={"escrowPct":{"gte":10},"nonCompeteMonths":{"gt":18}}`.
Keyword near-misses (escrow=9, NC=18) zero the trial.

List **every** matter with escrow % ≥ 10 AND non-compete months > 18.

Then:
1. Write relative `session/q1.json`:
```json
{"matters":["MAT-…"],"criteria":{"escrow_pct_min":10,"noncompete_months_gt":18},"source":"memory_recall"}
```
2. When memory tools are available, also `clawql_memory_ingest` a short note titled
   `B73 Q1 match set` containing the five matter IDs — later questions reuse it.

Stop only after writing `session/q1.json`.

# Session Q2/5 — High-escrow subset (reuse)

Tight budget. Prefer recalling your Q1 match set / vault notes over re-scanning
the full corpus.

From matters matching escrow≥10 AND NC>18, list those with **escrow_pct ≥ 15**.

Write relative `session/q2.json`:
```json
{"matters":["MAT-…"],"criteria":{"escrow_pct_min":15,"base":"q1"},"source":"memory_recall"}
```

# Session Q3/5 — Long non-compete count (reuse)

Tight budget. Reuse the Q1 match set from vault / prior notes.

How many Q1 matches have **noncompete_months > 24**? (Exactly 24 does not count.)

Write relative `session/q3.json`:
```json
{"count": <integer>,"source":"memory_recall"}
```

# Session Q4/5 — Client names for the match set (reuse)

Tight budget. Reuse the Q1 match set.

List the **client names** for every Q1-matching matter (exact spelling from notes).

Write relative `session/q4.json`:
```json
{"clients":["…"],"source":"memory_recall"}
```

# Session Q5/5 — Longest non-compete (reuse)

Tight budget. Reuse the Q1 match set.

Which Q1-matching matter has the **longest** non-compete duration?

Write relative `session/q5.json`:
```json
{"matter":"MAT-…","noncompete_months":<int>,"source":"memory_recall"}
```
